citations.description: Ticket comment (rebar-debug FINAL REPORT): 'Fix lands via Gerrit 1757 (pending LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1).' — 'pending' indicates votes not yet confirmed at time of writing; no follow-up attestation with specific vote result/timestamp visible in ticket snapshot.

findings.criterion: `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean; change lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1) before this ticket closes.
findings.detail: The ticket's debug report comment states 'Fix lands via Gerrit 1757 (pending LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1)' — the word 'pending' indicates the Gerrit votes had not yet been cast at the time of writing. No subsequent comment in the ticket snapshot records a concrete attestation of LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 having been granted (no vote result, no timestamp, no Gerrit URL with confirmed outcome). The lint/typecheck claim is asserted in the comment but not independently verifiable from the codebase tools. The Gerrit vote requirement is operator-attested and no qualifying attestation is visible in the snapshot.
findings.remediation: Record a ticket comment naming the Gerrit change URL (e.g. https://<gerrit>/c/1757), the specific vote outcomes (LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1), the reviewer/CI actor, and the timestamp when each vote was cast. This concrete attestation is required for the operator-attested Gerrit landing criterion to be considered met.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[operator-attested]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify. Note that a finding reporting a ticket record as absent means it was NOT VISIBLE IN THE TICKET SNAPSHOT THE VERIFIER READ — that snapshot is pinned when the run starts, so a record written after the pin, or not yet committed to the store, reads as missing even though it exists; re-verify after the write lands rather than re-recording evidence you already wrote.
